financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 2,000,000 shares at $2.11 with 2,000,000 warrants; closing expected on or about May 16, 2022
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $3.66 million after deducting the placement agent fee and estimated offering expenses payable by us.

warrants.quote: Pursuant to the Offering, the Company will also issue 5-year warrants to purchase 2,000,000 shares of Common Stock, exercisable at a price of $2.45 per share
